title: Girona is spectacular
text: Our private tour guide, Christian, was excellent… he gave us as much time as we needed at each stop and never rushed us. There’s something special about having a private guide and we had the good fortune of having one as knowledgeable and fun as Christian.
author: Monica_P

title: Girona private driver for a day trip.
text:
Syed was wonderful. He’s a great driver and had a lot of knowledge about the history of the area. 

We did not have a lot of time in Pals and Parapadella. Could have spent more time in one and skipped the other. 

Seemed quite expensive but it was nice to have someone else doing all the driving. 

Traveling with my adult daughter. There isn’t an option for just family.
author: DeborahJo_E
